quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email as a self-employed person formally contesting an error in your tax assessment.
options: Dear Assessments Team,
Subject: Formal dispute - assessment reference tx-77213

Your assessment appears to have counted a client payment twice, once under the invoice date and once under the payment date, which has inflated my declared income by approximately £3,000, so I would like to formally request a correction based on the bank statements I have attached.

Yours faithfully,
Margaret Okonjo
quests.hint: The reference number anchors the formal subject; the assessments team is addressed by role, not name; the specific error and the supporting evidence are in the body; the closing must match this unnamed greeting.
quests.explanation: Identifying the precise mechanism of the error - counting one payment under two different dates - shows genuine understanding of the mistake rather than a general complaint about the total. Attaching bank statements as evidence gives the authority everything needed to verify and correct the figure quickly.
